description: This source file defines a RecyclerView adapter (TopNavAdapter) for a top navigation bar in an Android TV application. It manages a list of navigation category items, including a special search icon item, providing focus behavior and visual feedback suitable for TV interface navigation.
external_files: R (resources, specifically layout item_top_nav_tab and strings)

classes.name: TopNavAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter managing the top navigation categories list, includes logic for focus handling and item differentiation.

classes.name: TopNavVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual top navigation tab items, handles bind logic and focus/selection behaviors.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Submits a new list to the adapter for display, inherited from ListAdapter.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates item layout and creates ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for display.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Configures the view elements of a navigation item, managing focus visuals, content description, and click/keyboard interactions.
